fr.elements: Main Residence; Access Drive; Front Driveway; Detached Structure; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of the road.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow fire apparatus to reach the residence without obstruction.
• Create a turnaround area near the residence or detached structure large enough for emergency vehicles to reverse direction without backing out to the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive to maintain overhead and side clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure to open a clear path around both buildings for responders on foot.
• Thin dense vegetation between the road and the structures so responders can see the buildings and assess conditions on approach.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings quickly.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Brush Area; Mixed Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Shrubs; Long Driveway; Vegetation Along Driveway; Open Terrain; Tree Cluster; Ground Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and low branches that are directly touching or leaning against the house walls.
• Clear ground vegetation within several feet of the foundation on all sides of the house.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest the structure to create open space between individual trees and between the trees and the house.
• Remove shrubs growing beneath trees near the house to reduce the connection between ground-level plants and tree canopy.
• Cut back or remove brush in the dense brush area closest to the structure.
• Thin scattered shrubs around the house so they are separated from each other and from the building.
• Clear vegetation growing along both edges of the driveway so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Trim overhanging tree branches above the driveway to maintain overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Remove dead or dry ground vegetation along the driveway that could carry fire toward the house.
• Keep the area between tree clusters and the structure open by removing shrubs and ground cover that connect them.
• Thin mixed vegetation on the sides of the house where plants are densest to create visible open gaps around the building.
• Maintain the open terrain areas by preventing shrub or brush encroachment toward the structure over time.
